messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — need to schedule a 45m cross-functional engineering+product meeting next week to finalize model routing priority and finish a couple RFC reviews. Short agenda below. Vote availability with :one: / :two: / :three: or reply with conflicts.

Luis Gomez: +1. Prefer option 2 (Wed 4pm PT).

Priya Rao: Option 2 works for me. I’ll own the RFC review for 'routing policy'.

Tom Chen: Option 1 or 2. I can own the design review for the console rollout.

Jenna Ortiz: Option 2 only for me. Need to hand off the Friday triage slot — I can do a 10m handover during the meeting.

Maya Patel: Cool — tentative leaning to option 2. Draft agenda:
```
1) RFC: model routing policy (Priya) — 15m
2) Design review: console rollout (Tom) — 15m
3) Triage handover + decision log (Jenna) — 10m
4) AOB / scheduling next steps — 5m
```

Luis Gomez: Fine. Can we make it 50m if discussions run long? Also priors: please add a 1‑page pre-read. Priya, can you attach RFC link?

Priya Rao: Yup attaching PR: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/PR-241 — will add TL;DR and a risks list.

Tom Chen: I'll post screenshots and a short note on the UI constraints here.

Jenna Ortiz: I can update the decision log afterwards. Who wants to co-author the log entry? @Luis Gomez?

Luis Gomez: I can do the first pass on the decision log. :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: OK finalizing: Wed 16:00 PT / 19:00 ET, 45m. Agenda owners: Priya (RFC), Tom (Design), Jenna (Triage). Calendar invite shortly from @Calendabot.

Calendabot: Created event 'Crossfunc roadmap & triage' Wed 16:00 PT — invite sent to channel attendees.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — if you can't make it please drop a comment with constraints and we'll try to handle async handoff or record the session. :v:

Priya Rao: Adding pre-read and short bullet points now.

Tom Chen: Dropping UI pngs in a min.

Jenna Ortiz: Will prep triage runbook snippet and handover checklist.

Luis Gomez: Noted, I’ll review the RFC pre-read before the meeting. See you on Wed.
